title: Injectivity of (x, λ) ↦ ofReal(λ⁻¹^n)•μ₀.map(dilation x λ) for a finite nonzero μ₀ concentrated on B_2(0): total mass recovers λ, barycenter recovers x (parent step 2)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, and let μ₀ be a measure on ℝ^P with μ₀(ℝ^P) ≠ 0, μ₀(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞ and μ₀(B_2(0)ᶜ) = 0. If x, x' ∈ ℝ^P, λ, λ' > 0 and ofReal(λ⁻¹^n)•μ₀.map(dilation x λ) = ofReal(λ'⁻¹^n)•μ₀.map(dilation x' λ'), then x = x' and λ = λ'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → μ₀ univ ≠ 0 → μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ → μ₀ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 2)ᶜ = 0 → ∀ (x x' : Euclid P) (lam lam' : ℝ), 0 < lam → 0 < lam' → ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam'⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x' lam') → x = x' ∧ lam = lam'
